rationale: CampaignPlan is validated as part of the existing v1alpha1 campaign format, so an optional free-form per-plan version is redundant and cannot safely select a contract. Keeping it creates a second, potentially conflicting version authority without a current use case.
alternatives: keep as a required, constrained document-format discriminator only if plans must be independently decoded across concurrently supported formats
derive the format from the enclosing campaign/package contract
simplestChoice: Remove it; let the enclosing campaign format and generated schema define the plan contract.
